data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cincinnati = ee.Geometry.Point([-84.5120, 39.1031]) # Approximate center of Cincinnati, Ohio

year_2018 = 2018
feb_2018_start = f'{year_2018}-02-01'
feb_2018_end = f'{year_2018}-03-01' # End of February is start of March for GEE filtering

reference_years = list(range(2010, 2018)) # 2010 to 2017

# 2. Data Acquisition
# ERA5-Land Hourly data, 2m_temperature band
# Temperatures are in Kelvin, need to convert to Celsius.
collection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \
    .select('2m_temperature')

# --- Process 2018 February data ---
col_2018 = collection.filterDate(feb_2018_start, feb_2018_end).filterBounds(cincinnati)

if col_2018.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print(f"No ERA5-Land data for February {year_2018}.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# Calculate the mean temperature for Feb 2018
mean_temp_2018_k = col_2018.mean()

# Check for valid pixels before reducing (optional for reanalysis, but good practice)
pixel_count_2018 = mean_temp_2018_k.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=cincinnati,
    scale=5000, # ERA5-Land resolution is ~9km, 5km scale is good
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('2m_temperature').getInfo()

if pixel_count_2018 == 0 or pixel_count_2018 is None:
    print(f"No valid pixels for February {year_2018} after processing.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# Get the value for Feb 2018
feb_2018_mean_k = mean_temp_2018_k.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=cincinnati,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('2m_temperature').getInfo()

if feb_2018_mean_k is None:
    print(f"Calculation failed for February {year_2018}.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

feb_2018_mean_c = feb_2018_mean_k - 273.15


# --- Process reference period (2010-2017) February data ---
february_means_c = []
valid_reference_years = 0

for year in reference_years:
    feb_start = f'{year}-02-01'
    feb_end = f'{year}-03-01'

    col_year = collection.filterDate(feb_start, feb_end).filterBounds(cincinnati)

    if col_year.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"  Warning: No data for February {year}. Skipping.")
        continue
    
    mean_temp_year_k = col_year.mean()

    # Get the value for the current February
    feb_mean_k = mean_temp_year_k.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=cincinnati,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('2m_temperature').getInfo()
    
    if feb_mean_k is None:
        print(f"  Warning: Calculation failed for February {year}. Skipping.")
        continue

    february_means_c.append(feb_mean_k - 273.15)
    valid_reference_years += 1

if valid_reference_years == 0:
    print("No valid data found for any reference February (2010-2017).")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>") # Or C3 if it's due to calculation failure on existing data
    exit()

# Calculate the average of the reference Februaries
reference_avg_c = sum(february_means_c) / valid_reference_years

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"Feb 2018 Mean Temp (C): {feb_2018_mean_c:.2f}")
print(f"Reference (2010-2017) Avg Feb Temp (C): {reference_avg_c:.2f}")
print(f"Valid reference years: {valid_reference_years} out of {len(reference_years)}")

if feb_2018_mean_c > reference_avg_c:
    print("<answer>A</answer>") # Yes, 2018 was warmer
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>") # No, 2018 was not warmer
